title: [Book][Request] Validate a Child (CHD) passenger assigned an Exit Row seat is rejected server-side
request_summary: Book (GulfAir/KSA, BAH-RUH 2027-07-08) assigning CHD passenger (Laila Ibrahim, age 10) to exit-row seat 18C
response_summary: 200 - real booking created (pnr QVUTYI), both passengers ticketed, no rejection
expected: Response status is an error (candidate error code RESTRICTED_EXIT_ROW_SEAT_FOR_CHILD, per this suite's Seat map - Seatmap.md TC-INT-BOOK-008 reference) and no pnr is created for this attempt
actual: DEFECT CONFIRMED: Book accepted the CHD-in-exit-row assignment with HTTP 200, created a real PNR (QVUTYI), and issued a real ticket for the CHD passenger (722136995695) in the exit-row seat, with no rejection, warning, or downgrade of any kind. The server itself computed PAX2.age=10 (proving passenger-type/age data was available server-side at Book time) yet still did not enforce the restriction this test case checks for.
evidence: pnr QVUTYI; passengersList.PAX2={passengerTypeCode:CHD, age:10}; passengersSelectedSeats.PAX2.cellCode=18C (cellCharacteristics include EXIT_ROW_SEAT); tickets.PAX2.ticketNumber=722136995695

summary: BUG-09 (recurrence, 7th confirmed occurrence, not a new defect) - Book still does not enforce the Exit Row seat restriction for Child (CHD) passengers. First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25, milder silent-drop form), reproducing in this worse zero-validation form (seat actually attached and ticketed) continuously since Round 2 (2026-08-26). 23-day gap since the last confirmation (Round 6, 2026-09-06).
expected_value: HTTP error (candidate RESTRICTED_EXIT_ROW_SEAT_FOR_CHILD), no pnr created
impact: A real-world aviation safety rule remains silently unenforced after 7 confirmed occurrences over 35 days. The server computes and returns the passenger age (10) at Book time, so the data needed to enforce this was available. Worth escalating: this has moved from newly-discovered to long-standing-unaddressed - recommend confirming with the platform team whether this is actually on a remediation backlog. See NDC_Integration/Artifacts/BugReports/20260929-090138_SeatMap-GulfAir-KSA-Round9/BUG-09_Book_passengersSelectedSeats_ExitRowCHD.md for full history across all 7 occurrences.
evidence: pnr QVUTYI (this run); passengersList.PAX2={passengerTypeCode:CHD, age:10}; passengersSelectedSeats.PAX2.cellCode=18C (cellCharacteristics include EXIT_ROW_SEAT); ticket 722136995695 issued for PAX2. Prior occurrences: Round1 pnr RRHRNS (milder), Round2/3/5/6 all confirmed in worsened form (see BUG-09 report History table).

note: Real Book succeeded and issued tickets for both passengers (PAX1 722136995694, PAX2 722136995695) - GulfAir/KSA, BAH-RUH 2027-07-08, CHD in exit-row seat 18C. This booking is this run's evidence for BUG-09 (recurrence, 7th confirmed occurrence - first observed Round 1, 2026-08-25) - do not void until the defect is triaged/confirmed by the platform team, then void per SPEC.md §2.15 (voidCapability=FullVoidOnlyAllowed).
